summary: Shutterstock filed an 8-K reporting the immediate departure of CEO Paul J. Hennessy on July 12, 2026. CFO Rik Powell was appointed Interim CEO, retaining his CFO role. Hennessy will remain as a non-executive advisor through August 7, 2026. The departure is not due to any disagreement. The Board will search for a permanent CEO. Powell received additional compensation: $75,000/month as Interim CEO and a $450,000 RSU grant vesting at six months, forfeitable for cause or voluntary resignation. This is an abrupt management change, not a routine succession. Watch for the permanent CEO appointment and potential strategic shifts.
